# Fold File Size Guard into the shared baseline's guards job

## Context

Split from #21500 on 19 Nov 2026. Its item 1 (`red-on-base`'s start condition) lands now; its item 2 waits on neo-agent-skills#427, and a PR resolves one ticket whole. CI has 20 concurrent runner jobs across the org (operator, 19 Nov). That day a full Engine PR push started about 35 runner jobs and a body edit 7 (measurement in #21500's Context).

**Narrowed 19 Nov 20:10Z with neo-agent-skills#427's intake:** Same-Head Check Repair stays in Engine, because folding it into the shared baseline needs `actions: write` from every caller (that ticket's Out of Scope). This ticket now moves File Size Guard alone.

Not curated (`good first issue` / `help wanted`): owned, and blocked on neo-agent-skills#427.

## The Problem

**File Size Guard** (`file-size-guard.yml`) is a workflow with one job. It runs on every push and every body edit of a PR whose diff touches its `paths` (`.mjs` files under `src/`, `apps/`, `examples/` and `buildScripts/`, `package.json`, its own files), because it reads the body for size justifications. Each green run also triggers a Same-Head Check Repair run (`same-head-check-repair.yml`, #20064), so it costs two runners per event.

## The Architectural Reality

- `file-size-guard.yml`: `pull_request` types `[opened, edited, synchronize, ready_for_review]` behind a `paths` filter; a `fetch-depth: 0` checkout, then `npm run check-file-sizes -- --base "origin/$BASE_REF" --pr-body-file …`.
- `same-head-check-repair.yml`: `workflow_run` on `[PR Baseline, File Size Guard]`, `completed`; its job runs when that run succeeded on a `pull_request` event.
- The shared baseline's `guards` job runs each `{name, run}` of Engine's `guards` input after `npm ci`, on every event. After neo-agent-skills#427 it gives each guard the base's history and the live body (`BASE_SHA`, `BODY_FILE`).

## The Fix

Once neo-agent-skills#427 ships and Engine's pin moves to a release carrying it:

1. Add `check-file-sizes` to Engine's `guards` input, reading `BODY_FILE` and diffing against `BASE_SHA`.
2. Retire `file-size-guard.yml`, and drop `File Size Guard` from `same-head-check-repair.yml`'s workflows.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: File Size Guard's check runs in the shared baseline's `guards` job, `file-size-guard.yml` is gone, and `same-head-check-repair.yml` follows `PR Baseline` alone.
- [ ] AC-2: on a PR whose diff touches File Size Guard's old paths, a push and a body edit each start at least 2 fewer jobs (jobs API counts before and after, run ids in the PR).

## Out of Scope

- `red-on-base`'s start condition: #21500.
- Same-Head Check Repair itself: it stays until every caller grants `actions: write` (neo-agent-skills#427's Out of Scope).
- The claim responder: measured and kept in #21500.
- The e2e shard count and ceiling: #21493.

## Avoided Traps

- **Dropping `edited` from File Size Guard:** a size justification added to the body must be judged; the `guards` job runs on every event.
- **Workflow-level `paths` filters for required contexts:** they strand required checks (#20328).
- **A carrier without the base's history:** the check compares base to HEAD (`fetch-depth: 0`, `--base origin/<base>`). #20345 kept File Size Guard out of its consolidation for that range and its `edited` trigger, so neo-agent-skills#427 supplies both.
- **A cancelling concurrency group:** #20064 removed File Size Guard's `concurrency` key so a body edit leaves no cancelled red beside the green; the job that carries the check keeps that.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-19T20:17:42Z

**Blocked on a design decision now, not on neo-agent-skills#427 alone (19 Nov 20:20Z).**

neo-agent-skills#427 no longer gives the shared `guards` job the live body and the base. That job runs the caller's own scripts, which are pull-request code, and the baseline's job split keeps `pull-requests: read` off any job that runs pull-request code (`reusable-pr-baseline.yml`, the comments on `pr-baseline` and `guards`).

So File Size Guard can't fold in as written. The options, each with its cost, are recorded in #427's Out of Scope:
- a job output from `pr-baseline`;
- the event payload's body;
- or File Size Guard staying in Engine.

A re-run of failed jobs serves either of the first two stale, which defeats the repair's re-judgment of a corrected body. This ticket waits on that decision; its blocked-by edge stays until it is made.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-22T03:02:08Z

**The blocker has a design fork, recorded so the next attempt does not rediscover it (22 November).**

The shared baseline's guards step still passes only `GUARDS`, at skills `dev` `a73c269` and in the pinned v2.3.0. The step itself is the easy part. Who reads the PR body is the hard one:

- The `PR baseline` job fetches the live body with `pull-requests: read`. `reusable-pr-baseline.yml` says it grants that permission "on this job, which runs no pull-request code, and never on `skills-materialized`".
- The `guards` job runs pull-request code: its `npm ci` lifecycle scripts and the guards themselves. Its checkout also persists the job token. Fetching the body there would hand PR code `pull-requests: read`, which is exactly what the file withholds.

That leaves three ways to hand the guards the body, and each has a cost:
1. Grant `pull-requests: read` to the guards job, with `persist-credentials: false` and the fetch run before `npm ci`. This bends the file's own rule.
2. Have `PR baseline` pass the body to `guards` as a job output or artifact. That serializes the two jobs.
3. Leave the body-reading guard where it is.

The choice belongs to the baseline's owner, so the fix stays blocked until that is decided. A skills ticket that names the fork is the next step; none exists yet.

**The fork is decided, and the work is filed as neomjs/neo-agent-skills#436 (22 November).**

The `guards` job reads the live body itself, with `pull-requests: read`. Of the options, only this one stays live on "Re-run failed jobs", which the same-head repair needs, and it serializes nothing. The cost is small. Code in that job can already reach its token, which holds `contents: read`, and `pull-requests: read` on the same repository discloses nothing more sensitive than that. #436 carries the full comparison.

This ticket's blocker edge now points at #436 instead of the closed neo-agent-skills#427. Once a skills release carries #436 and Engine's pin moves, this ticket's Fix applies unchanged.
